artifact_safety_ceiling: 64 MiB local safety ceiling for one retained artifact; intentionally much larger than Run History records and not a report-size eviction policy
usage_warning: navigator.storage.estimate usage plus the candidate artifact reaches 80 percent of quota
quota_policy: warn when the browser exposes quota, fail explicitly when projected usage reaches quota, and never delete older evidence automatically
metadata_listing_policy: listArtifacts reads only metadata envelopes; bytes are hydrated only for explicit inspect/download verification

fixture_measurement.measurement: artifact bytes are generated from the same report model; exact byte sizes remain content and locale dependent

browser_variance: Quota and usage are optional browser APIs; unavailable estimates do not block a valid artifact write.
